<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.2.5</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.clinictraining</groupId>
    <artifactId>med-backend</artifactId>
    <version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>jar</packaging>
    <name>med-backend</name>
    <description>Medical training backend application</description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>22</java.version>
        <spring-boot.version>3.2.5</spring-boot.version>
        <!-- Override Byte Buddy for Java 25 compatibility -->
        <byte-buddy.version>1.17.5</byte-buddy.version>
        <!-- Override maven-compiler-plugin for Java 25 compatibility -->
        <maven-compiler-plugin.version>3.13.0</maven-compiler-plugin.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <!-- Spring Boot Starters -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-security</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-graphql</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-webflux</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-aop</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-cache</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Database -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
            <artifactId>flyway-core</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Embedded PostgreSQL for demo mode (no Docker required) -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.zonky.test</groupId>
            <artifactId>embedded-postgres</artifactId>
            <version>2.0.7</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Caching -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.github.ben-manes.caffeine</groupId>
            <artifactId>caffeine</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- MapStruct -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.mapstruct</groupId>
            <artifactId>mapstruct</artifactId>
            <version>1.5.5.Final</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.mapstruct</groupId>
            <artifactId>mapstruct-processor</artifactId>
            <version>1.5.5.Final</version>
            <scope>provided</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Groovy -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.codehaus.groovy</groupId>
            <artifactId>groovy</artifactId>
            <version>3.0.19</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- XML Processing -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>jakarta.xml.bind</groupId>
            <artifactId>jakarta.xml.bind-api</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-oxm</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.ws</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-ws-core</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- JWT -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId>
            <artifactId>jjwt-api</artifactId>
            <version>0.11.5</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId>
            <artifactId>jjwt-impl</artifactId>
            <version>0.11.5</version>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.jsonwebtoken</groupId>
            <artifactId>jjwt-jackson</artifactId>
            <version>0.11.5</version>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Jakarta Servlet API -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>jakarta.servlet</groupId>
            <artifactId>jakarta.servlet-api</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Test Dependencies -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.testcontainers</groupId>
            <artifactId>testcontainers</artifactId>
            <version>1.19.7</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.testcontainers</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
            <version>1.19.7</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.testcontainers</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>1.19.7</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <configuration>
                    <source>${java.version}</source>
                    <target>${java.version}</target>
                    <annotationProcessorPaths>
                        <path>
                            <groupId>org.mapstruct</groupId>
                            <artifactId>mapstruct-processor</artifactId>
                            <version>1.5.5.Final</version>
                        </path>
                    </annotationProcessorPaths>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>${spring-boot.version}</version>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

content.text:
### Maven Checkstyle Plugin configuration in pom.xml

Source: https://checkstyle.org/getting-started.html

Add this plugin to the <plugins> section of your pom.xml. It specifies the Checkstyle configuration file location and pins the Checkstyle dependency to version 14.3.0, which is the version documented on this site. The Maven plugin has its own release cycle, so the explicit dependency ensures the documented version is used.

```xml
<plugin>
  <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
  <artifactId>maven-checkstyle-plugin</artifactId>
  <version>3.6.0</version>

  <configuration>
    <configLocation>config/checkstyle/checkstyle.xml</configLocation>
  </configuration>

  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.puppycrawl.tools</groupId>
      <artifactId>checkstyle</artifactId>
      <version>14.3.0</version>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
</plugin>
```

--------------------------------

### setFailOnViolation(boolean) - CheckstyleAntTask

Source: https://checkstyle.org/apidocs/index-all.html

Sets flag - whether to fail if a violation is found.

```APIDOC
## setFailOnViolation(boolean) - CheckstyleAntTask

### Description
Sets flag - whether to fail if a violation is found.

### Method
setFailOnViolation

### Parameters
- **failOnViolation** (boolean) - Required - Flag to fail if a violation is found.

```

--------------------------------

### 2. Run Checkstyle > Maven

Source: https://checkstyle.org/getting-started.html

Add the Maven Checkstyle Plugin to the `<plugins>` section of your `pom.xml`:

```xml
<plugin>
  <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
  <artifactId>maven-checkstyle-plugin</artifactId>
  <version>3.6.0</version>

  <configuration>
    <configLocation>config/checkstyle/checkstyle.xml</configLocation>
  </configuration>

  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>com.puppycrawl.tools</groupId>
      <artifactId>checkstyle</artifactId>
      <version>14.3.0</version>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
</plugin>
```

Run:

```bash
./mvnw checkstyle:check
```

If your project does not use the Maven Wrapper, use `mvn checkstyle:check`.

The Maven plugin has its own release cycle, so the Checkstyle dependency above is specified explicitly to use the version documented on this site.

Once the setup works, you can configure Checkstyle to run automatically as part of your Maven build. See Maven integration for the available options.

content.text:
Context7 obejmuje tylko stronę checkstyle.org. Osobnej biblioteki z dokumentacją `maven-checkstyle-plugin` (maven.apache.org) w nim nie ma. Dlatego z Context7 potwierdziłem tylko wersje, `configLocation` i polecenie uruchomienia. Pozostałe parametry podaję z własnej wiedzy i nie są sprawdzone w źródle.

## Fragment do `backend/pom.xml` (w `<build><plugins>`)

```xml
<plugin>
    <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
    <artifactId>maven-checkstyle-plugin</artifactId>
    <version>3.6.0</version>
    <configuration>
        <configLocation>${project.basedir}/checkstyle.xml</configLocation>
        <consoleOutput>true</consoleOutput>
        <failOnViolation>true</failOnViolation>
        <failsOnError>false</failsOnError>
        <violationSeverity>warning</violationSeverity>
        <includeTestSourceDirectory>true</includeTestSourceDirectory>
    </configuration>
    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.puppycrawl.tools</groupId>
            <artifactId>checkstyle</artifactId>
            <version>14.3.0</version>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>
</plugin>
```

Sekcji `<executions>` celowo nie ma, więc plugin nie jest podpięty pod żadną fazę. Konfiguracja leży na poziomie `<plugin>`, a nie w `<execution>`. To ważne, bo polecenie `./mvnw checkstyle:check` używa wykonania `default-cli` i konfiguracji z `<execution>` by nie zobaczyło.

## Parametry

**Biblioteka w Context7: `/websites/checkstyle`** (źródło: checkstyle.org)

- **Wersja pluginu 3.6.0 i `com.puppycrawl.tools:checkstyle` 14.3.0.** Źródło: https://checkstyle.org/getting-started.html
  > „pins the Checkstyle dependency to version 14.3.0, which is the version documented on this site. The Maven plugin has its own release cycle, so the explicit dependency ensures the documented version is used."
- **`configLocation`.** Na tej samej stronie przykład `<configLocation>config/checkstyle/checkstyle.xml</configLocation>` i polecenie:
  > „Run: `./mvnw checkstyle:check`"
- **`failOnViolation`.** Context7 zwrócił tylko odpowiednik z zadania Ant (`CheckstyleAntTask`), nie z pluginu Maven:
  > „failOnViolation … Whether to fail build on violations."

**Spoza Context7, do sprawdzenia na https://maven.apache.org/plugins/maven-checkstyle-plugin/check-mojo.html**

- `consoleOutput` (domyślnie `false`): wypisuje naruszenia na konsolę.
- `failOnViolation` (domyślnie `true`): przerywa build, gdy liczba naruszeń o poziomie ≥ `violationSeverity` jest większa niż `maxAllowedViolations`.
- `failsOnError` (domyślnie `false`): przerywa build już w fazie generowania raportu, przy naruszeniach o poziomie `error`. Do samego `check` wystarczy `failOnViolation`.
- `violationSeverity` (domyślnie `error`): najniższy poziom, który liczy się jako naruszenie. Ustawiłem `warning`. Jeśli reguły w `checkstyle.xml` mają poziom `warning`, przy wartości domyślnej build by nie padał.
- `includeTestSourceDirectory` (domyślnie `false`): sprawdza też `src/test/java`.

## Uwagi

- Spring Boot 3.2.5 przez parent zarządza starszą wersją tego pluginu. Jawne `<version>3.6.0</version>` ją nadpisuje.
- Checkstyle 14.x prawdopodobnie wymaga nowego JDK (21+), ale tego nie sprawdziłem w Context7. Projekt i tak używa JDK 22–26.
- Plugin sprawdza też `legacy/`, więc przy pierwszym uruchomieniu może zgłosić dużo naruszeń. Jeśli tak będzie, wyklucz ten katalog przez `<excludes>` albo dodaj plik tłumienia ostrzeżeń w `<suppressionsLocation>`.
